udgītha
------------------------------------------
The mantras of the Sāmaveda are called ‘sāman’. Each सामन् has five fundamental steps in singing. Out of them the second—which is the main part—is known as the ‘udgītha’. It is sung by the main priest उद्गातृ. It always begins with Oṁ.
See also SĀMAN.

udgātṛ
(‘the chanter’)
------------------------------------------
In any Vedic sacrifice, four principal priests are involved. The उद्गातृ is the third priest representing the Sāmaveda. His main duty is to chant the sāmans (mantras of the Sāmaveda) at the appropriate stages in the sacrifice. Sometimes he is also to perform some minor rites.
He has three assistants. They are: प्रस्तोतृ, pratihartṛ and सुब्रह्मण्य.
